action.rationale: Fresh start with 100 evaluations left on a 14D, deterministic, cheap objective; probing (~12% of budget) will reveal modality and local structure before committing to a method. This follows the probe-first principle to guide method selection and warm-start subsequent runs from the archive.

Probes suggest multiple basins and weak global structure (fdc_spearman=-0.1608; top10_spread_vs_uniform=1.214), in 14D with 88 evals left. A short race between TuRBO and CMA-ES hedges between trust-region BO and an evolution strategy, both warm-started from the 12 archived evaluations.

CMA-ES just won the race and is early in its run (generation 1, popsize 11, sigma 0.278) with no convergence flags, improving the best from 0.498 to 0.349 in 12 evals and only 1 stall eval. With 64 evals left, continuing should capitalize on this momentum before considering restarts or polishing.
